description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker recipe for Qwen's official Qwen3.5-122B-A10B-FP8 (block-wise FP8, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision a099dee7) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: InstantTensor loading, prefix caching, qwen3_coder tool parsing, qwen3 reasoning parsing, eugr's fix-qwen3.5-chat-template mod (baked into the image at build time; the unsloth chat template it installs is selected with --chat-template), 262,144-token context, 8,192 batched tokens and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults); scheduler sequence capacity is left to vLLM as upstream does not set it. Upstream marks this recipe cluster-only (the FP8 weights do not fit one Spark), so there is no single-Spark recipe. This is upstream's recipe as written (tensor parallel 2); the Controller runs it as native multi-node vLLM (eugr's default no-Ray cluster mode, instead of --distributed-executor-backend ray). No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Qwen3.5 122B-A10B FP8 vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
